# SelectionSlider { #anylumino.astryx.SelectionSlider }

```python
SelectionSlider(
    items,
    value=None,
    *,
    label='',
    marks=False,
    disabled=False,
    value_display=None,
    description=None,
    **props,
)
```

Render an Astryx slider that steps through discrete options.

Astryx ``Slider`` works on a linear numeric scale, so this wrapper drives it
over option indices and synchronizes the selected option value. Pass a
two-item ``value`` to select a range instead of a single option.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                   | Description                                                                              | Default    |
|---------------|----------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items         | Iterable\[Any\] \| Mapping\[str, Any\] | Option labels, ``(label, value)`` pairs, or a label to value mapping.                    | _required_ |
| value         | Any                                    | Selected option value, or a two-item sequence for a range. Defaults to the first option. | `None`     |
| label         | str                                    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                           | `''`       |
| marks         | bool                                   | Whether to draw a labelled tick for every option.                                        | `False`    |
| disabled      | bool                                   | Whether the component should render disabled.                                            | `False`    |
| value_display | str \| None                            | Tooltip, text, or hidden value presentation.                                             | `None`     |
| description   | str \| None                            | Helper text displayed with the input.                                                    | `None`     |
| **props       | Any                                    | JSON-safe Slider props forwarded to Astryx.                                              | `{}`       |
| See           |                                        |                                                                                          | _required_ |
